text: In late June 2026, a stray mother dog known online as "Wangwang" was brutally abused and killed in Jieyang, Guangdong, China. According to official statements and multiple media reports, four boys under the age of 14 attacked the mother dog and her puppies. The puppies were beaten to death, and the mother dog was later set on fire. The incident was recorded on video and spread widely online, sparking public outrage in China and internationally翻譯中文 翻譯如下： 旺旺虐狗事件 2026年6月下旬，中國廣東省揭陽市一隻在網路上被稱為「旺旺」的流浪母狗，遭到殘忍虐待並死亡。根據官方通報及多家媒體報導，四名未滿14歲的男孩攻擊了這隻母狗及牠的幼犬。幼犬遭到毆打致死，而母狗隨後更被縱火焚燒。整個事件被拍攝成影片並在網路上廣泛流傳，引發中國國內及國際社會的強烈憤怒與譴責。 江明聰 ·
